question: Which of the following sport was not played in the Summer Olympics 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ice Skating**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__

• **Ice Skating**, which includes sports like figure skating, speed skating, and ice hockey, is traditionally associated with the **Winter Olympics** rather than the Summer Olympics.

• The Summer Olympics 2024, scheduled to take place in **Paris, France**, features sports that are typically played in warmer climates or indoors.

• The core sports in the Summer Olympics include disciplines like **Badminton**, **Lawn Tennis**, and **Basketball**, which are all part of the 2024 Paris Games program.

• The **Winter Olympics** specifically focus on sports played on ice or snow, such as skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating. The most recent Winter Olympics were held in **Beijing, China, in 2022**.

• **Ice Skating** has never been part of the Summer Olympics, as its nature and infrastructure requirements align with the Winter Games. Hence, it is excluded from the Summer Olympics 2024 lineup.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• **Summer Olympics 2024:**

• The **Paris 2024 Summer Olympics** will feature 32 sports and 329 events, including new additions like **breakdancing** (debuting as a sport).

• Other popular sports include **athletics, swimming, gymnastics, cycling, and basketball**.

• The games will take place from **July 26 to August 11, 2024**.

• **Winter Olympics Overview:**

• The **Winter Olympics** focus on sports played on snow and ice, including **ice skating**, bobsleigh, curling, and ski jumping.

• These events require specialized venues such as ice rinks and snow-covered mountains.

• The next Winter Olympics will be held in **2026 in Milan-Cortina, Italy**.

• **Ice Skating Categories:**

• **Figure Skating:** Combines artistic performance with technical skating skills.

• **Speed Skating:** A race between competitors on an ice track.

• **Ice Hockey:** A team sport played on ice with a puck and sticks.

• **Sports in Both Olympics:**

• While most sports are exclusive to either the Summer or Winter Olympics, some, like **cycling** and **biathlon**, have variations in both.

• However, **Ice Skating** remains strictly a Winter Olympic sport.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

• **Badminton:**

• Badminton has been part of the Summer Olympics since **1992 (Barcelona)**.

• The sport involves singles and doubles events played indoors.

• **Lawn Tennis:**

• Tennis first appeared in the Olympics in **1896** and was reintroduced in **1988**.

• It is played on various surfaces, including grass, clay, and hard courts.

• **Basketball:**

• Basketball was introduced to the Olympics in **1936 (Berlin)**.

• It is a globally popular team sport and includes both men’s and women’s events.

• **Ice Skating:**

• Ice skating is exclusively a Winter Olympic sport, with events like figure skating and speed skating.

• It requires freezing temperatures and specialized ice arenas.

8c
